about: Input: the raw CAD after /home/claude/work/hcls-2024-ftc-offseason-bot/prep-robot.mjs, which leaves out the duplicate slide kits (the retracted copy of the 336 mm kit except its belt, the retracted 240 mm kit), the duplicate claw mount and finger, and the fasteners, then groups the parts into G_* nodes by their STEP paths and joins each group by material. Every G_ group stays separate (the rig moves them); the rest is merged by material.
